definitions.full: H4245. machaleh [ מַחֲלֶה ] noun [masculine] sickness, disease — suffix מַחֲלֵהוּ Prov 18:14 his sickness (= any sickness of his); of specific disease, construct מֵעֶ֑יךָ מַחֲלֵה 2Chr 21:15 (+ מֵהַחֹ֑לִי רַבִּים, בָּחֲלָיִים ). מַחֲלָה noun feminine sickness, disease , מַחֲלָה Exod 15:26 3 t. — sickness, disease , (in General) 23:25 (JE); so with כל , 1Kin 8:37 2Chr 6:28 (|| כלנֶֿגַע ), Exod 15:26 (J E; compare רֹפְאֶ֑ךָ יהוה אני near the end)
